query: What was the Roud Folk Song Index of the nursery rhyme inspiring What Are Little Girls Made Of?

pipeline_result.response: The Roud Folk Song Index number of the nursery rhyme "What Are Little Boys Made Of?" is 821. This index indicates that the song draws inspiration from a nursery rhyme with a specific line in the fourth position, which translates to the year 1839 (since the index numbers are typically arranged by year).
retrieved_context: What Are Little Boys Made Of?: "What Are Little Boys Made Of?"  is a popular nursery rhyme dating from the early 19th century.  It has a Roud Folk Song Index number of 821.

What Are Little Girls Made Of?: "What Are Little Girls Made Of?"  is episode seven of the of the American science fiction television series, "".  It was first broadcast October 20, 1966, and repeated, two months later, on December 22, the first episode of the series to be repeated on NBC.  It was written by Robert Bloch and directed by James Goldstone.  The title of the episode is taken from the fourth line of the 19th century nursery rhyme, "What Are Little Boys Made Of? ."
